translations.web: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
translations.bsb: So he inquired as to the hour when his son had recovered, and they told him, “The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour.”
translations.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
translations.asv: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to amend. They said therefore unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
